_comment: Per-operation metadata for the broker's 55 operations. tools/gen_help.py holds this key set equal to the operations ops.rs dispatches, so a new operation without a row here fails the generator's --check. agent_reach: mcp = exposed as an MCP tool; capability_only = an agent-origin caller that holds the capability could send it to the broker socket, there is no MCP tool and an agent must not use it; human_only = needs Admin, the owner's login or presence, which an agent scope never carries; bootstrap = vault setup, unlock, step-up and lock operations any local process may send, which an agent never needs.

audit.get.summary: The full, unredacted record of one decision. Built, but refuses everyone with presence_required in this build.

audit.tail.summary: Recent audit records. For an agent the feed is redacted to id, action, time and actor.

entry.create.summary: Create a new entry (one value or several fields). On a locked vault it is held in the pending tray.

entry.create_batch.summary: Create 1 to 500 entries in one all-or-nothing call (used by credmgr import).

entry.get.summary: One entry's metadata: field ids, labels, types, masking. Never a value.

entry.list.summary: Entry names and ids on one node. A human session also gets type, sensitivity and counts.

entry.remove.summary: Soft-delete an entry into a 7-day recovery window.

entry.restore.summary: Bring a removed entry back inside its recovery window.

entry.reveal.summary: Return field values. Waits for a human when the vault is locked or the node asks for a second factor.

entry.rotate.summary: Replace a value and keep the previous one as history.

entry.undo.summary: Undo a rotation, a field change or a removal, addressed by its audit record id.

entry.update.summary: Replace a field's value or the whole field list. Keeps no history.

field.reorder.summary: Change the order of an entry's fields. Presentation only.

field.update.summary: Change one field's label, value, type or masking.

grant.create.summary: Create a grant between nodes. Built up to its gate, then refuses with presence_required in this build.

graph.snapshot.summary: The node tree the desktop app draws, filtered to what the caller may list.

maintenance.backup.summary: Write an encrypted backup archive under a passphrase the human chooses.

maintenance.doctor.summary: Diagnose and fix safe drift; optionally purge seals older than seven days.

maintenance.rotate_root.summary: Replace the root key and issue a new recovery code. Refuses with presence_required in this build.

maintenance.verify.summary: Check every envelope and manifest against its digest.

node.create.summary: Create a project or sub-node, optionally with work folders.

node.list.summary: List nodes the caller may see.

node.policy.summary: Change a node's policy by partial patch. A patch that widens reach refuses with presence_required.

node.reparent.summary: Move a node under a different parent. Refuses with presence_required in this build.

node.restore.summary: Restore a sealed node within seven days.

node.seal.summary: Seal a node: its entries move to Orphaned, re-encrypted to the cold key.

node.set_workdirs.summary: Bind directories to a node so an agent started inside is scoped to it.

node.update.summary: Rename a node (the label only; the id never changes).

notes.read.summary: Read a node's markdown note. Needs the notes capability, which an agent scope never carries.

notes.write.summary: Write a node's markdown note. Needs the notes capability, which an agent scope never carries.

search.summary: Search entry names across the nodes the caller can reach. Names only.

totp.code.summary: The current six-digit code for a stored authenticator seed. Never the seed.

totp.seed.summary: The stored seed itself. Refuses every caller with presence_required in this build.

util.generate.summary: Generate a random password (8 to 128 characters). The value is in the answer only: not stored, not audited.

vault.approval_decide.summary: Approve or deny an agent's waiting request. On a locked vault the passphrase (and the authenticator code) decide it.

vault.approval_get.summary: Describe waiting agent requests. Works on a locked vault and decrypts nothing.

vault.gate_enroll_begin.summary: Start setting up or replacing the vault's second factor.

vault.gate_enroll_confirm.summary: Confirm the second factor with one code; issues ten recovery codes.

vault.gate_recover.summary: Reset the second factor with the passphrase and the root recovery code. Never unlocks.

vault.gate_verify.summary: Complete an unlock that asked for a code, or, from a logged-in session, open a five-minute step-up window.

vault.init_begin.summary: Start creating the vault (only when none exists).

vault.init_confirm.summary: Finish creating the vault by retyping the recovery code.

vault.lock.summary: Lock the vault and end every login.

vault.node_lock.summary: Lock one node while the vault stays unlocked.

vault.pending_accept.summary: Accept a held entry into its node. This is the human's review step; an agent must not use it.

vault.pending_discard.summary: Discard a held entry. This is the human's review step; an agent must not use it.

vault.pending_list.summary: List entries held in the review tray (names and counts, never values).

vault.status.summary: Whether the vault is locked, initialised, and how many agent requests wait.

vault.unlock.summary: Unlock with the passphrase; returns a login token, or asks for a second-factor code.

whoami.summary: The caller's own node, capabilities and the nodes it can reach.
